all! That's
adorable beyond words!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:

yesterday!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, can you see me? I'm right
here!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: I cannot see you at all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Whoa, really?! Yippee! I did it!
